title: Staged Intake and Weighted-Scoring Process for Pricing & Billing Requests
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a staged intake workflow and a transparent weighted-scoring matrix to triage incoming customer requests related to pricing, commitments, invoicing, cost allocation, and marketplace credits. The goal is to reduce time-to-decision, increase fairness of allocation, and surface high-impact enterprise needs to Sales/Finance/Legal quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Public intake form (hosted on Confluence/Drive) with required fields for financial impact and contract references
A working weighted scoring sheet (Google Sheet) that outputs a routing tier (FastTrack / Standard / Low) and a numeric priority score
Automation/triage runbook that pockets requests to the correct steward queue (Billing Ops / Finance / PM / Legal) within SLA
Dashboard card in Console (internal) showing weekly intake volume, average score, and average decision time
Pilot with two AE cohorts and Billing Ops for 4 weeks with measured SLA improvements (goal: 50% faster decisions for high-impact requests)
scoring_components: Revenue upside (0-40): ARR impact or committed payment delta over 12 months
Compliance/regulatory risk (0-30): legal/regulatory blockers that prevent shipping
Operational complexity (0-15): engineering/billing effort to implement
Strategic alignment (0-10): ties to enterprise motions (Dedicated/Private)
Customer urgency (0-5): customer stated deadline and go-live constraints
routing_policies: Score >= 60 => FastTrack: PM + Billing Ops + Sales lead review within 3 business days
Score 40-59 => Standard: Review in next weekly pricing forum (7 business day SLA)
Score < 40 => Low: Triage into backlog; PM provides quarterly summarization
Must-link: any request with 'contract modification' or 'invoice credit > $25k' auto-sends to Finance and Legal
data_requirements: Baseline ARR / monthly spend and proposed change
Required GxP/compliance notes or data residency constraints
Attachments: copy of PO/contract amendment or marketplace order for verification
